name: effect-holo-sheen
title: Holographic Sheen
description: Một dải cầu vồng xiên lướt qua nền thẻ và đổi sắc nhẹ, chữ và nội dung phía trên giữ nguyên màu.

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: A rainbow band (52 px wide, rotated ~29°, stops transparent → red → yellow → green → blue → transparent) sweeps with its centre from −50 % to +120 % of the card width (recipe −120 % → 220 %) in 1300 ms sine.inOut, additive, opacity 0.55·sin(π p)^0.4, with hue-rotate 0 → 55° → 0; drawn under the card's content so only the background shimmers. Params: duration (1.3 s) · width (52 px) · angle (≈29°) · opacity (0.55) · hue (55°). The band runs under the card's content: only the background shimmers.
